entities.name: Nitro isoquinolinone substrate
observations: Structure is decoded as O=C1N[C@H](C(=O)O)Cc2ccc([N+](=O)[O-])cc21, a nitro-substituted tetrahydroisoquinolinone-like scaffold.

entities.name: Amino isoquinolinone product
observations: Structure is decoded as O=C1N[C@@H](C(=O)O)Cc2ccc(N)cc21, the corresponding aryl amine.

entities.name: Aromatic nitro reduction
observations: Net transformation is chemoselective conversion of an aromatic nitro group to an aniline; the lactam carbonyl, carboxylic acid, and fused-ring framework are retained.
The apparent stereochemical change may reflect representation or standardization rather than a demonstrated stereochemical reaction event.

entities.name: ORD ord-2d14567638444dd3aa4254878ae0af33
observations: Closest documented record reports 99.7% yield for nitro-to-aniline reduction using PtO2 in acetic acid.
The stored reaction representation lists acetic acid as solvent and PtO2 as catalyst; hydrogen is not explicitly listed but catalytic hydrogenation with H2 is the likely interpretation.

entities.name: PtO2 in acetic acid
observations: Database-supported condition for this transformation: PtO2 catalyst in AcOH, with reported 99.7% yield in the closest ORD record.
H2 is a plausible implied hydrogen source, but is not explicitly listed in the stored reaction SMILES.

entities.name: Alternative nitro reductions
observations: Chemically plausible but not directly supported for this exact record: Pd/C-H2, Raney Ni-H2, Fe/NH4Cl, SnCl2/HCl, and Zn/NH4Cl.
